tools.name: resolve_place
tools.description: Look up a Dutch municipality, town, district, neighbourhood, postcode, street or address by name and get its Huisly slug. Use the slug with search_listings (location), get_place_insights (type and slug) or, for an address, get_property (property_slug).

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search current Dutch rental or for-sale listings in one place with optional price, size, room and property-type filters. Returns at most 10 listings (facts only, newest first unless sorted by price), the total number of matches, a link to the full results on huisly.nl, and a search_token. Pass the s

tools.name: get_property
tools.description: Get the facts of one Dutch home: address, size, building, its current listings with links to every source website (where to apply, rent or buy), a listing-history summary, and the energy label registered in EP-Online (RVO). Pass property_slug from search_listings or resolve_place, or listing_id for

tools.name: get_place_insights
tools.description: Get neutral CBS (Statistics Netherlands) figures for a Dutch municipality, district or neighbourhood: headline figures and a few per category (housing, population, income, energy, nearby amenities and more), each with its period and the comparison with the wider area and the Netherlands, plus source

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search Huisly's own guides on renting, buying and moving in the Netherlands (for example rental contracts, deposits, rent rules, transfer tax, mortgages, registration, and city moving guides). Returns summaries with links; use get_guide for the outline, FAQs and official sources of one guide.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Get one Huisly guide by slug (from search_guides): its summary, outline, a short excerpt, its FAQs and the official sources it cites, with a link to the full article on huisly.nl.

tools.name: get_new_listings
tools.description: Return only the listings first seen by Huisly within the last window_hours (at most 168, one week) for a search_token from search_listings, or say explicitly that there are none.
